title: GuardianTrade
tagline: Fetch.ai-powered risk agent that monitors your wallet and warns you before crypto disasters.
description: GuardianTrade is a real-time crypto risk protection agent powered by Fetch.ai. It monitors a user’s wallet continuously, analyzes smart contract safety, whale movements, liquidity health, and volatility, then alerts the user before losses hit. Using MeTTa reasoning, the agent recognizes danger patterns like rug pulls or scam behavior instead of relying only on price changes. Users can simply send a monitor command through ASI One or the web interface, and the agent becomes a 24/7 AI guardian for their portfolio.
how_its_made:
GuardianTrade is powered by a Fetch.ai uAgent that monitors a user’s wallet, scores risk in real time, and sends alerts through the ASI One chat interface. The core logic is written in Python, and MeTTa reasoning helps the agent recognize dangerous patterns like rug pull indicators, liquidity drains, and whale dumping — not just price movement.

We use the 1inch Portfolio API to track holdings and pricing data, which feeds into our risk engine. A simple Next.js frontend lets users start monitoring their wallet with one command. A fun hack was crafting custom MeTTa rules so the agent can make smarter decisions, instead of relying only on thresholds.

Everything works together to feel like messaging an intelligent bodyguard for your crypto rather than checking a dashboard.
